name: Genestealer

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (p.133).

abilities.name: Swift and Deadly
abilities.text: The Threat Seizes the Initiative without spending a point of Ruin and Charges. It gains an additional +1 bonus die to its attack Test as part of the Charge.

determination: Lightning Reflexes: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.

mobAbilities.name: Flurry of Claws
mobAbilities.text: As long as all individuals in a Mob of Genestealers target the same opponent, they gain +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.
